title: ESP AIMBOT FOV INF AMMO AND MORE
features:
Aimbot Improvements:

Fully reworked Aimbot – Improved target acquisition, smoother tracking, and better performance.

FOV Circle – Customizable radius, color, and transparency; visual feedback when locked on target.

Hold/Toggle Key System – Choose between hold or toggle mode with any key binding (mouse or keyboard).

Team Check & Wall Check – Configurable to avoid teammates and respect obstacles.

Aimbot Smoothing – Adjustable from instant to smooth tracking.

NEW Movement Tab:

Fly Hack – Toggle with INSERT key; WASD + Space/Ctrl controls; adjustable speed (20-200).

Noclip – Walk through walls; toggle with DELETE key.

Fly Speed Slider – Customize flight velocity on the fly.

ESP:

ESP Toggles – Player Name and Box ESP (requires Drawing support).

Gun Modifications:

Rainbow Gun – Dynamic color cycling for weapon models.

Infinite Ammo – Standard quality-of-life feature.

Misc:

Infinite Jump – Toggleable infinite jumping.

UI & Visuals:

Fixed UI – All tabs (Main, Movement, ESP, Gun, Misc, Credits) now display correctly in WindUI.

New "Movement" tab – Centralized all mobility features.

Clean UI integration – No visual glitches or overlapping elements.

Controls:

Key    Action
K    Open/Close UI
INSERT    Toggle Fly
DELETE    Toggle Noclip
WASD    Move / Fly
Space    Fly up
Ctrl    Fly down
Right Click    Aim Assist (hold)
Works on:

Delta

Solara

Velocity

Xeno

Any executor with Drawing support

Thank you for your support!
